trades.reasoning: Full four-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) justifies a measured entry even as the broader index sits flat to slightly negative.

decisions.briefing: Markets were roughly flat today with NASDAQ -0.3% and S&P 500 -0.4%, a neutral tape overall. Despite that, ALAB showed genuine institutional-grade momentum (all four confirmation signals), so we took one measured position while leaving remaining cash and slots in reserve for a clearer risk-on day.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no single dominant catalyst, reflecting a quiet, indecisive session rather than broad selling pressure. Within that flat tape, select semiconductor and AI-infrastructure names like ALAB continued to show strong volume and trend signals, showing that individual stocks can diverge from the index. This kind of stock-specific strength during an otherwise neutral market is common when a company has its own catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 大盤今日輕微回落,納指跌0.3%,標普500跌0.4%,並無明顯單一利空消息,屬於觀望性質的平淡交易日。不過在大盤整體持平的背景下,部分半導體及AI基建相關股份如ALAB仍錄得强勁成交量及趨勢訊號,反映個股走勢可以與大盤脫鈎。這種在中性市況下的個股強勢,通常源於該公司本身的利好因素。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Market divergence happens when individual stocks move opposite to or independently of the broader index. Today the overall market was flat-to-slightly-down, but certain stocks with strong company-specific momentum still showed bullish signals, which is why a selective buy can still make sense even on a neutral market day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 市場背離是指個股走勢與大盤脫鈎的現象。今日大盤整體持平略跌,但部分個股因本身具備強勁動能訊號仍然造好,所以即使在中性市況下,精選個別強勢股仍然合理。
